CustomZones.Title: Custom Zones
CustomZones.NewZoneHint: Choose the zone it behaves like: it uses that zone's demand, and you then pick which of its buildings may grow.
CustomZones.Name: Name
CustomZones.NoStyles: Nothing can grow yet: choose at least one building style below.
CustomZones.MissingWidths: Lots of the dimmed widths stay empty: add a style that has them if you want those lots built.
CustomZones.BigHint: Install Building Icon Generator to see real pictures of every building.
CustomZones.ClickToRemove: Click to remove it from this zone
CustomZones.ClickToAdd: Click to let it grow in this zone
CustomZones.Place: Place one to see it in the city
CustomZones.LevelUpHint: When off, buildings in this zone keep the level they were born with, while other zones keep levelling up.
CustomZones.KeepDesignHint: On: a building only becomes the next level of itself (same name). Off: it may become another building of this zone at the next level, like the game does with every building.
CustomZones.NoBuildings: Nothing can grow yet: choose at least one building below.
CustomZones.GrowsInZone: This level grows in this zone
CustomZones.DemandNoHousing: No housing demand for this density right now: it will not grow until there is
CustomZones.DemandNoneGoods: Nothing can grow right now: the city has no demand for
CustomZones.DemandNoneHousing: Nothing can grow right now: the city has no demand for this kind of housing.
CustomZones.DemandSome: can grow right now · no demand for
CustomZones.DemandYesLong: The city needs more of it right now, so it can grow.
CustomZones.DemandNoLong: The city does not need more of it right now: it will not grow, even in this zone, until there is demand.
CustomZones.HelpCard: Click a card to let the level it shows grow in this zone (a tick appears).
CustomZones.HelpLevels: The numbers 1-5 are its levels: click one to add or remove that level. Filled = grows in this zone, outlined = the one on the picture, dim = it does not exist.
CustomZones.HelpZoom: The magnifier shows it large, with every level, and lets you place one in the city.
CustomZones.HelpGoods: Under the name: its lot size and what it sells, makes or stores.
CustomZones.HelpDemand: In red with a warning: the city does not need more of it right now. A building only grows when there is demand for what it sells or makes, even when this zone allows it.
CustomZones.GrowthGrowing: Growing: the city is choosing buildings for its free lots
CustomZones.GrowthNoLots: No free lots right now: paint this zone along a road (or every lot is already built).
CustomZones.GrowthNothingFits: Its buildings do not fit the free gaps left. Normal when the zone is nearly full; if it is empty, add buildings of other sizes or paint deeper zones.
CustomZones.GrowthNoDemand: Its buildings fit, but the city has no demand for them right now.
CustomZones.GrowthLowScore: The city wants them, but not here yet: this spot scores too low for them (workers, education, services, land value, pollution or road access).
CustomZones.GrowthTypeNoDemand: The city has no demand for this type of zone right now (its demand bar is empty), so nothing of this type grows anywhere.
CustomZones.GrowableHint: Only buildings the city has demand for right now (the ones that can grow).
